answer.reason: The verses state two chief deeds of Cyrus: his proclamation to rebuild the house at Jerusalem and his bringing out of the temple vessels.

clauses.english: proclaimed that the house of the LORD be built in Jerusalem and the people go up
clauses.quote: he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

clauses.english: brought out the temple vessels Nebuchadnezzar had taken and gave them to Sheshbazzar
clauses.quote: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD

doubts: EZR 1:3 is cited for the go-up call though it is not marked; it is context within the same proclamation.
ISA 44:28 and ISA 45:1 are prophecies about Cyrus (shepherd, anointed), not events, so left out.
EZR 4:5 and DAN 10:1 only date events by his reign and were left out.
